fields.label: Enable Warehouse Guard
fields.description:
Each stock item must use its default warehouse, resolved like ERPNext does: Item Defaults of the Item, then its Item Group, then its Brand (for the document's company). Items without a default warehouse are not checked.
Strict (home warehouse only): Sales Order, Delivery Note, Sales/Purchase Invoice with Update Stock, Purchase Order, Purchase Receipt, Material Request of type Purchase / Customer Provided / Subcontracting.
Flexible (home or production warehouse): Stock Entry and other Material Requests.

fields.label: When a Wrong Warehouse Is Used
Additional Production Warehouses
fields.description: Production warehouses already include the default WIP, Finished Goods and Scrap warehouses of Manufacturing Settings, the company's In Transit warehouse and the warehouses of a linked Work Order / Subcontracting Order, with their child warehouses. Add more here (e.g. team or subcontractor warehouses); child warehouses are included.
